## Collaboration and talks 

I am glad to speak at seminars, workshops, and reading groups on:

- Construction and measurement of reliability and agreement
- Longitudinal and multilevel modeling
- Mathematical and computational models of judgment and decision-making

Past talks and slides are listed under [Presentations](publication.qmd#presentations).
